description:
Looking for an opportunity to make an impact? 
 At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business. 
 
 Are you ready for your next challenge? 

 The Defense Sector at Leidos currently has an opening for a Software Engineer. This is an exciting opportunity to use your experience helping the C-sUAS Engineering and Integration mission. In this mission we integrate data from existing C-sUAS infrastructure, radars, and sensors at various locations/sites to aim at controlling the airspace from sUAS.

   
 THE CHALLENGE (primary responsibilities) 

 Develop and maintain software for a robust C-sUAS software suite
 Design software to support system integration efforts
 Ensure any new code meets contractual cyber standards
 Collaborate with government customers to better understand program needs.
 Communicating issues with leadership
 Identify areas of improvement that can benefit the software process
   
 WHAT SETS YOU APART (basic qualifications) 

 Bachelors’ Degree with 8 – 12 years of prior relevant experience or Masters with 6 – 10 years prior relevant experience.  
 Must possess and maintain active DoD Secret clearance or above to be considered for role. (US Citizenship required) 
 Experience Working with multiple programming languages such as (C#, C++, Python, Java) 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, a demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, and a strong problem-solving mindset 
 Familiarity with the Atlassian suite, including Jira and Confluence 
 Familiarity with Gitlab 
 Familiarity with Docker and Linux based containerization 
 Ability to mentor other software engineers 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 

 Previous experience working with C-sUAS sensors and effectors
 Experience working on projects with a multitude of repositories
 Experience implementing agile methodologies
 Experience with cyber tools such as Fortify, Sonarqubue, Trivy, Dependency Tracker
 Experience with Go or JavaScript
 Experience using NATS messaging framework
  
 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
 
 
 Original Posting: 
November 17, 2026 
 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.







 
 
 Pay Range: 
Pay Range $107,900.00 - $195,050.00 
 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
